rules.name: Keep each runtime independently locked
rules.statement: Claude and Codex runtime packages retain their own committed lockfiles and must not float dependencies during an unattended run.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Preserve the engine boundary
rules.statement: Runtime adapters translate the shared Touchstone candidate contract without moving verification, publishing authority, or another engine's credential into the model process.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.
